title: Item 16a · One meaning, one icon
subtitle: Approved in each section, plus drift. The rule (§2.3): “Same icon = same meaning everywhere … never use two icons for one meaning.” Today several meanings have two or three icons, and two icons mean two things: the clock is “Not paid” in Color Belt and Star but “Paying on schedule” in Black Belt (both are rows in the icon map, v0.229 and v0.914; v0.229 also names Camps, which never built that card), and Star's repeat icon is both “Make-up” and “Change how they'll pay”. Forms' pencil and Finance's “Today” icon were never decided (drift). Already settled: 12b removed Black Belt's lock icons and Forms' door icons. Next, 16b: icons missing from the map, Forms' own icons, and tooltips on icon-only buttons. (Icons drawn from the app's own Tabler set; cards are preview screenshots at PC size · fake data)

items.caption: 1. Today: one meaning, two or three icons — and the clock and repeat icons each mean two things. Color Belt's own event menu even shows Restore both ways (plain; with the Undo icon when it is grayed for a student moved to private testing).
2. Color Belt's cards (Star the same): Not paid = clock.
3. Black Belt's cards: the clock is “Paying on schedule” and Not paid is a circle-x.

columns.label: Proposed (option B) · one icon per meaning

items.caption: 4. Proposed: one icon per meaning, picked from what the sections already use.

columns.note: What changes where: Color Belt — Not paid card, Change how they'll pay, Restore, the No-show result. Star — Not paid card, Change how they'll pay. Camps — Restore, the day grid's ✓ / ✗ become the Came / Didn't come icons, and its new To collect card (11b) takes the Not paid icon. Forms — Edit. Finance — Today loses its icon. Black Belt, Prospects and Calendar already match. The two “Not paid” rows in the icon map become one.

footer:
Your choice — one question: one icon per meaning?
A · Keep as today. + no work. − the clock means “not paid” in one section and “paying on schedule” in the next; Star's repeat means two things; came, didn't come and Restore each look two or three ways.
B · Recommended: one icon per meaning (picture 4). Each section swaps only the icons in its rows that differ (list on the right). + an icon means the same thing in every section, so a roster card or menu item reads the same everywhere. − small icon swaps in five sections.
C · Fix only what was never decided: Forms' pencil, Finance's Today icon and Star's double repeat; the approved differences stay (Not paid, Restore, came / didn't come). + least work. − the clock still means two things across sections, and came / didn't come still look different.
